       BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

        SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the Bl-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11-L in the area bounded by

              The north-south alley next east of North Milwaukee Avenue; West
              Montrose Avenue; North Milwaukee Avenue; a line 108.74 feet
              northwest of the intersection of North Milwaukee Avenue and
              North Montrose Avenue as measured along the east right-of-way
              line of North Milwaukee Avenue and perpendicular thereto; and
              the alley next north of West Montrose Avenue

       to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District and a corresponding use district is
hereby established in the area above described.

      SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.


       Address:      4401-4411 North Milwaukee Avenue/5040-5048 West Montrose Avenue,
                     Chicago, Illinois

8.    Present Zoning District Bl-1 Neiehborhood Shopping District

      Proposed Zoning District B3-1 Community Shopping District

9.    Lot size in square feet (or dimensions) 18,497 sq. ft.

10.   Current Use of the property The property is improved with a two story commercial building with
      20 parking spaces behind the property.

      Reason for rezoning the property No changes to the footprint or the envelope of the property are
      planned. The purpose of the rezoning is to change the zoning classification to one that permits
      general restaurants. Such use allows a tenant to secure an incidental liquor license.


11.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
      units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and
      height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)

      No changes to the footprint or the envelope of the building are planned. The purpose of the
      rezoning is to change the zoning classification to one that permits general restaurants. Such use
      allows a tenant to secure an incidental liquor license. The building exists as a two-story, 14,000
      square foot commercial building with existing 20 parking spaces on site.

12.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARC) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or
      a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a
      zoning change, which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing
      Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
      www.cityofchicago.org/ARC for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?

      YES                              NO         X
